The bar graphs report 'n=20' and significance levels, so a replicate number is given, but the caption never states what the n=20 units are (e.g., individual cells, images, or independent experiments), so the replicate type is not reported.
Panel C is a single representative Western blot with no quantification or replicate statement. There is no indication of how many times the blot was repeated or what constitutes a replicate.
